column1: # Recorded cat sounds, played instead of the synthesized ones when they are in the app.
# All CC0, by Joseph Sardin, from BigSoundBank (https://bigsoundbank.com/). Fetched,
# converted and copied into the app by scripts/fetch-cat-sounds.sh, called from
# scripts/build-app.sh. Kinds: meow (friendly meows), mew (short little meows, for pokes
# and chirps), angry (growls and yowls, for a woken or shaken cat), purr.
